nodes.label: Spectrogram Comparison: Natural vs f5_tts
nodes.description: Spectrogram comparison between natural speech and f5_tts synthesis for samples s3, s8, s12. Shows high visual fidelity of f5_tts with minor artifacts in voicing smoothness and harmonic consistency. Right columns are empty placeholders.

metadata.finding: f5_tts produces spectrograms very close to natural human speech, suggesting high-quality realistic audio with minor spectral artifacts
